label: shipping
goal: Order 1842 was placed Monday and still has no tracking email. The customer asks when it will arrive.
context:
# Northline fulfillment policy

## Shipping
Orders placed before 15:00 local warehouse time ship the same day. Standard ground delivery is 5 business days after shipment. Tracking is emailed when the carrier scans the parcel. Address changes are allowed only before the carrier scan.

## Billing
Duplicate card captures are reversed within 3 business days of the dispute ticket. Subscriptions may be cancelled any day; service continues through the paid period. Invoices are issued within 1 business day of a written request.

## Access
Password resets go through the email link that expires in 30 minutes. Two-factor recovery requires the backup code printed at enrollment. Locked accounts reopen after a successful reset.
